recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-28312 in core unless a future work-group decision changes the Resource $validate profile parameter again.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking that the Resource $validate operation profile input parameter use canonical instead of uri because profiles are canonical resources and version may matter.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied on the R4B branch by commit de542fc499c93c20ed4fe6c8f2d46914a4b5f1a0, which changed Resource-validate.profile from uri to canonical. Jira comments and FHIR-37997 show the change was later lost in the R5 migration, then restored by commit 378fe392dd102168828a322355a66656eff4d1bb.
additional_context: FHIR-37997 is the direct R5 regression tracker for the same parameter. Current source keeps the canonical type and includes the later FHIR-44864 StructureDefinition targetProfile constraint. The Resource operation definition is active current-build source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-validate.xml already implements the FHIR-28312 canonical type and later targetProfile constraint.

related_jiras.note: R5 regression tracker confirming the FHIR-28312 canonical change had been lost and needed restoration.
